---
title: "The document language overrides the extension language file"
format: langfile-html
toc: true
language:
  toc-title-document: "Contents from the document"
_quarto:
  tests:
    langfile-html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Contents from the document</h2>']
        - ['Contents from the extension']
---

## Section

The document sets `toc-title-document` under `language`.
The `langfile` extension sets the same key in its language file.
The value of the document must replace the value of the extension.
